name: Josep Tarradellas Barcelona-El Prat Airport

runway.v: three runways; the longest, 06L/24R, is 3,352 m long and 60 m wide

slots.v: in summer, general aviation slots (arrival and departure) are coordinated no more than 30 days ahead
slots.quote: During the summer season, general aviation slots (arrival + departure) will not be coordinated more than 30 days in advance.

max_aircraft.v: from June to September, aircraft of 15,000 kg MTOW or less cannot arrive between 07:00 and 11:30
max_aircraft.quote: they cannot operate arrivals within the time period 0700-1130

handling.v: the AIP lists AVIAVIP FBO, United Aviation FBO, ExecuJet Spain, General Aviation Service, Jetex Executive Aviation Barcelona, Skyvalet and Universal Aviation Spain as general aviation agents and FBO managers
handling.quote: General Aviation agents and General and Business Aviation terminal Managers (FBO):

noise.v: a special night runway configuration is used between 23:00 and 07:00 local
